name: Last Line of Defense: First Wave
summary: Last Line of Defense is a thrilling and addictive shooting game developed by Ninja Kiwi. In this action-packed game, you find yourself in a dire situation where hordes of zombies are relentlessly attempting to destroy your town and its inhabitants. Your mission is clear: you must stand as the last line of defense and protect the city from this undead menace.
